newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Large trade in FAI after market close.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Large trade in FAI after market close.

text.p: Large trade in FAI Insurances Ltd shares went through the market after the market close on Friday.
Brokers said the trade of 45.93 million FAI shares or about 15 percent of the insurer's issued capital was handled by Prudential-Bache Securities at 72 cents a share.
A broker at Prudential-Bache said the trade was handled through its Melbourne office, but would not disclose any further details.
FAI shares closed three cents higher at 73 cents on Friday.
FAI is controlled by the Adler family which owns about 30 percent of the company's issued capital.
The next largest shareholder is Premier Investments Ltd, which is controlled by businessman Solomon Lew.
Last August Premier upped its FAI stake to 14.42 percent, after it bought an 8.05 percent stake for around 50 cents.
